Subject: - Guidelines for dealing with Court Cases-regarding.
Sir,

Ministry of Labour & Employment, Govt. of India issued standard operating
procedure/guidelines for dealing with court cases where Union of India is party(copy
enclosed). On the basis of same, the following guidelines are issued for strict
compliance.

(a) Immediately on receipt of notice/writ petition/application etc., the concerned
officer (RPFC/APFC) shall personally go through the papers and see whether formal
reply/counter affidavit is required to be filed on behalf of Union of India or not.

(b) In all cases, where reply is required to be filed by Ministry, a draft reply will be
prepared on the behalf of Union of India and may be sent to Head Office for sending to
Ministry for approval if required, atleast 15 working days before the last date for filing
the reply before the Hon'ble Court.

{c) The officer concerned will keep track of each court case for taking follow up

action from time to time. The draft reply will be perused and vetted by ‘concerned’ ~ ”

RPFC/OIC before it is forwarded to Head Office for transmission to Ministry of Labour &
Employment for approval.

(d) In case of court orders/judgements, proper analysis of the order etc. shall be
made and the decision to implement or to challenge the order in the next higher court
shail be taken in consultation with Ministry if required within stipulated time to avoid
the contempt proceedings in the court.

(e) In contempt of court cases one officer who is weil acquainted with the facts of
the case, remain present in the court to ensure the effective handling of the case.

(f) The RPFC/OIC and Zonal ACC shall review all court cases pertaining to their
office on monthly basis and update the same in the Compliance MIS Software.

(g) It is seen that in some cases, the panel advocate fail to appear in the court on
the date of fisting of a particular case or fail to file the reply in the court within
stipulated time even after the draft reply is made available to him/her. Adequate and
timely precautions should be taken to eliminate such situation.

(h), In some cases,- where the consultation with the nodal Ministries i.e
DOPT/Ministry of Finance/Ministry of Law is required, reference to such Ministries
should be made immediately and same should be followed up to expedite the timely
disposal of cases. In case the court is required to be intimated, the reply should be that
the matter is under consideration with the Govt. and not an individuai Ministry.

2. These guidelines are in addition to those issued vide this office circular No.
LC-1(12)2013/CPFC ref./pt/3805, dated 16.05.2014.

Yours faithfully,
